basics.name: Rosmar Alejandra Mendoza Canchica
basics.label: Systems Engineer & Technical Project Manager | Agile & AI Delivery
basics.summary: Systems Engineer certified by the PMI in PMP® Fundamentals and CPMAI™, offering 7+ years of professional technology experience orchestrating critical software delivery across hyper-scale tech (MercadoLibre), fintech startups (Mo Technologies), and multinational banking (Scotiabank). Combines strong technical depth (distributed microservices, cloud APIs) with strategic project leadership: orchestrating Scrum/Kanban squads, governing 99%+ production availability SLAs, automating executive KPI dashboards in Power BI, and embedding generative AI frameworks to accelerate Time-to-Market and operational efficiency. Uniquely skilled at aligning business priorities with technical execution to drive predictable, high-impact releases.

work.name: MercadoLibre
work.summary: End-to-end technical delivery and operational coordination of critical distributed microservices at regional scale, leading sprint milestones, SLA compliance, and AI workflow integration.
highlights: Led agile squad orchestration under Scrum/Kanban across high-throughput distributed microservices; optimized backlog grooming and team capacity, improving sprint delivery predictability by 20%.
Spearheaded alignment between regional engineering, product, and operations teams; managed inter-team dependencies and mitigated delivery risks to guarantee continuous, frictionless releases.

Governed telemetry observability and incident triage protocols for mission-critical Golang services, conducting root cause analysis (RCA) to safeguard 99%+ platform availability for millions of users.
Architected and deployed generative AI operational workflows (Cursor, Claude, CPMAI™), accelerating code refactoring and test automation turnaround by 30%.
